feedback: The illustration perfectly captures the dejected fisherman by the quiet shores of Galilee at dawn next to his empty boat, matching the mood and description in the text seamlessly.
The illustration accurately captures the weary fisherman washing his weed-tangled net by the pebbled shore in accordance with the text.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus walking along the lakeshore in an off-white robe amid crowds while Peter watches from his nets.
The illustration captures Jesus teaching the attentive crowd from a boat on the shore, though Peter is missing from inside the boat.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus pointing to the water from the boat while a startled Peter clutches his net.
The illustration accurately depicts Peter's gesture of trust and obedience toward Jesus inside the fishing boat.
The illustration effectively captures Peter's astonished expression while hauling the heavy net alongside a serene Jesus on the lake.
The illustration perfectly captures Peter shouting urgently as he and his fellow fishermen haul an overflowing net of glistening fish into their boats under warm sunlight.
The illustration accurately depicts Peter kneeling in repentance before Jesus on a boat filled with fish under divine light.
The illustration nicely captures Jesus and Peter walking together along the shoreline leaving the fishing boats and nets behind.
